description: A narrow shop lined with pennants, caps on a tree by the door, foam fingers in a bin, and a glass counter of signed balls on stands. Two card machines hum in the corner, and the walls are papered with old game posters.

window.description: Pennants hung in fans in the window, faded on the street side. Sorrel Way is outside, and the Coliseum's south-west tower.
window.name: the shop window
